window-frame.intent: a deep blue timber frame holds the night beyond the room

night-pane.intent: one quiet dark pane, inset evenly inside its timber frame

outside-moon.intent: a small crescent makes the window unmistakably nocturnal

low-star.intent: a restrained distant star subordinate to the crescent

window-mullion.intent: a slim timber division keeps the view domestic

window-sill.intent: a broad warm sill supports the book and sleeping cat

sill-apron.intent: a dark front lip gives the resting surface a visible thickness

lamp-base.intent: a weighted shallow foot rests beside the cat

lamp-stem.intent: a slender upright joins the lamp base and shade

lamp-shade.intent: a broad golden shade opens toward the sleeping cat and book

lamp-rim.intent: a warm lower rim suggests the lit underside of the shade

sleeping-body.intent: a low oval back curls into a comfortable sleeping silhouette

far-ear.intent: the farther tapered ear breaks the round feline head silhouette

near-ear.intent: a forward ear gives the resting face a recognisable cat profile

sleeping-head.intent: a rounded head settles low beside the curled body

cat-muzzle.intent: a small pale muzzle separates the face from the orange coat

cat-nose.intent: a tiny dark nose finishes the quiet right-facing profile

closed-eye.intent: one softly arched lid communicates sleep rather than a blank face

book-left.intent: the left cream page tilts upward from the resting book gutter

book-right.intent: the second page mirrors its partner around an open gutter

book-gutter.intent: a slim dark gutter identifies the two planes as one open book

tucked-tail.intent: a clean round gesture mark with editable spine and terminals

book-cover.intent: a dark curved supporting cover tucked beneath both cream page planes

tucked-paw.intent: an editable rounded flat colour mass

scope: editable gesture strokes and colour masses, flat cartoon heads, front-view open hands, compact illustrative grips, owned upper bodies, persistent directional joints, planar locks and scenic recipes; no full 3D head/hand rig or whole-artwork acceptance claim

alignment_legend.blue: pinned stroke endpoints / inspected target; removal: retained affected children
alignment_legend.teal arrows: outward join direction where defined; center mounts can be directionless
alignment_legend.green rings: named mount points or protected endpoints/knuckle
alignment_legend.white target: local edge/spine, terminal, digit-tip or exact-mount focus

move_units: object: shorter canvas dimension; local edge: nominal lock width; shape contour: nominal shorter extent; stroke spine: thickness; stroke terminal: shorter canvas; digit tip: nominal digit span
